freshness_rule.definition: diff_hash = sha256 over the sorted changed-file list of (path + NUL + blob_sha_at_head(path)), computed vs merge-base with main
freshness_rule.name: diff-hash pinning
freshness_rule.repin: addendum comment naming the new diff hash + one line confirming the delta was read; accepted iff posted by the original scoring seat or co-signed by a second different seat in the same thread
freshness_rule.stale_condition: current diff_hash != scorecard pinned diff hash (head movement alone NEVER stales)
freshness_rule.tier_A_exception: Tier A keeps exact-head pinning; any head move requires a full re-score

unified_gate.determinism_rule: one evaluation per (head, trigger-event); full predicate-by-predicate result posted as PR comment and mirrored as check-run output; a duplicate run at the same head must reproduce the identical verdict or the gate files a defect note against itself
unified_gate.matcher: reuse tools/check_merge_consensus.py scorecard predicate; no second matcher
unified_gate.name: Paperwork gate (scorecard + evidence)

predicates.rule: gate-format scorecard comment on the PR (header + ## SCORECARD block with head/seat/score/verdict)
scorecard seat != PR author declared Seat (case-insensitive)
score >= tiers.B.scorecard_min AND verification attestation present in scorecard body
scorecard pinned diff hash == current diff hash (see freshness_rule)
every link/handle in PR body ## Evidence section resolves (HTTP 200 or API-resolvable); bare backticked identifiers fail

value_law.edge_rule: Push to the edge of what is possible; know where the edge is; never cross it.
value_law.statement: An 8/10 that ships beats a 9.5 that never lands. Gates protect the system; a gate that blocks flow is a defect.
